evidence: gpt-oss-120b uses "parity[i] ... bipartite side"; qwen3-coder says "build a graph where each edge represents a constraint"; glm-5 builds adjacency and performs "constraint propagation" on values 1 and 2
affordance_in_statement: Each lens axis "must be an integer value of either 1 or 2" together with the condition "S_i + d_i \cdot c_i = 3 d_i"
removal_suggestion: Do not display the condition in the explicit S_i + d_i c_i = 3d_i form. Present the same requirement indirectly as a total glare score computed from each tube incidence, requiring contestants to derive that every incident pair has complementary axis values. This can obscure the reduction, but the bipartite structure itself cannot be removed without changing the task.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes that every ordinary edge must connect opposite values and solves the resulting bipartiteness problem.
Converts each tube into a binary constraint between its endpoints, effectively solving graph two-colorability.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: "We'll build a graph where each edge represents a constraint"

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses adjacency-based propagation of the two possible axis values, which is the same bipartite-coloring reduction.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The adjacency construction followed by "c[i] = 0: unassigned, 1 or 2: assigned" and constraint propagation

common_affordance: The equation plus the binary domain forces every non-loop tube to join lenses with opposite axes, reducing the entire problem to bipartite graph coloring.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Although it correctly derives that c_i = 1 requires all incident neighbor contributions to be 2 and c_i = 2 requires them to be 1, its submitted propagation/orientation logic does not consistently complete a valid lexicographically smallest assignment.

recommended_edit: Replace the explicit algebraic equation with an equivalent indirect definition of the diagnostic score over tube incidences, so the bipartite-coloring reduction is not handed to the solver syntactically; there is no semantic edit that removes this structural reduction while preserving the task.
regression_risk: A mere re-presentation may allow the already-defeated deepseek-v4-flash to solve the problem if its propagation bug was caused by misunderstanding the displayed equation rather than by its implementation.
